auth.heroTitle: Make room for <highlight>the work that matters.</highlight>
auth.heroBody: Track time with a team workspace that lives in your own Firebase project.
auth.heroFooter: Open source · Self-hosted · No seat limits

auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.

autoApproved.type: Approved automatically: this type needs no approval.

mine.title: Time off
mine.empty: No time off requested for this year yet.
mine.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? The days go back to your balance.
mine.submittedPending: Request sent. It is pending approval.

request.title: Request time off
request.startHalf: First day is a half day
request.endHalf: Last day is a half day
request.usesUnlimited: Uses {{days}}. This type has no limit.
request.weekendsNote: Weekends are not counted. Public holidays are not taken into account yet.
request.overWarning: This goes over your allowance by {{days}}. You can still send it; it will be marked as over allowance.

problem.dates: Choose the first and last day.
problem.end-before-start: The last day must be on or after the first day.

approvals.title: Time-off approvals
approvals.intro: Pending requests from your team. Nobody approves their own request: yours go to another manager or the owner.
approvals.empty: No requests are waiting for a decision.
approvals.ownRequest: Your request: someone else decides it.
approvals.cancelConfirm: Cancel this approved leave for {{name}}? The days go back to their balance.

approved.title: Approved leave in {{year}}
approved.intro: Approved leave across the workspace. Members can cancel their own leave until it starts; after that, an approver cancels it here.

balances.title: Balances and allowances
balances.intro: Available days per member and type. Set a member's allowance for the year or add an adjustment with a note, such as days carried over.
balances.ownAllowance: Ask the owner to change your own allowance.

allowance.title: {{name}} · {{year}}
allowance.overrideHelp: Leave empty to use the type's default ({{default}}).
allowance.overrideInvalid: Enter whole or half days between 0 and {{max}}.
allowance.adjustHelp: Use a minus sign to remove days, e.g. -1. The reason is shown with the adjustment.
allowance.adjustmentInvalid: Enter whole or half days other than zero, e.g. 2 or -0.5.
allowance.noteRequired: Add a reason for the adjustment.

types.title: Leave types
types.intro: Types members can request, their default yearly allowance (per calendar year), and whether they need approval. Archived types can no longer be requested.
types.name: Name
types.defaultAllowanceHelp: Leave empty for no limit. Members' allowances can be changed one by one.
types.requiresApprovalHelp: When off, requests are approved as soon as they are sent.

team.title: Team time off
team.intro: Approved and pending leave for everyone in the workspace, one row per member. Weekends are shaded, and the last row counts who is off each day.
team.empty: No approved or pending leave in {{month}}.

import.title: Import from Clockify
import.intro: Bring your history over from Clockify. In Clockify, open Reports → Detailed, choose the date range and export it as CSV. Then choose the file here: you see what will be imported before anything is saved.
import.fileEmpty: This file has no time entries. Export a Detailed report from Clockify as CSV and try again.
import.fileTooManyRows: This file has more than {{max}} rows. Export shorter date ranges and import the files one by one.
import.fileMissingColumns: This doesn’t look like a Clockify Detailed report. Missing columns: {{columns}}. Export the Detailed report as CSV with Clockify set to English.
import.dateFormatAmbiguous: Couldn’t tell from the file. Choose the date format your Clockify account uses.
import.timeZoneHelp: The time zone in your Clockify profile when you exported.
import.userNotMember_one: {{email}}: not a member of this workspace ({{count}} entry)
import.userNotMember_other: {{email}}: not a member of this workspace ({{count}} entries)
import.unknownUsersLabel: Entries of people who aren’t members
import.catalogNote: Names that already exist in this workspace are reused, including archived ones, which stay archived.
import.summaryReady_one: {{count}} entry ready to import, {{duration}} in total.
import.summaryReady_other: {{count}} entries ready to import, {{duration}} in total.
import.summaryShortened_one: {{count}} entry has a description or name longer than Ticknest stores. It will be shortened.
import.summaryShortened_other: {{count}} entries have a description or name longer than Ticknest stores. They will be shortened.
import.summaryOverlapNote: Entries that overlap time already in Ticknest are skipped, so importing the same file again doesn’t create duplicates.

reasons.invalidDate: the date can’t be read in the chosen date format.
reasons.invalidTime: the start or end time can’t be read.
reasons.endNotAfterStart: the end isn’t after the start.
reasons.taskWithoutProject: it has a task but no project.
reasons.unknownUser: the person isn’t a member of this workspace.
reasons.overlapsFile: it overlaps another entry of the same person in the file.
reasons.overlapsExisting: it overlaps an entry already in Ticknest.
reasons.overlapsRunningTimer: it overlaps the person’s running timer.
reasons.invalidRow: the row has values Ticknest can’t store.

import.stopped: The import stopped: {{message}} Entries already imported are kept. Choose the file again to import the rest; entries already imported are skipped.
